title: The upstream mmap transfer failure required the CUDA device alias
summary: A controlled reproducer isolated illegal CUDA access to using a CPU mmap address where the batch-transfer path needed its CUDA device alias. Mapped-address stores and restores passed byte equality.
scope: RTX 2080 Ti/WSL2; 7,168 descriptors of 16 KiB. A separate three-request Qwen2.5-7B-AWQ serving probe restored pinned CPU KV and matched outputs.
limitations: This is a specific compatibility result, not a blanket WSL limitation or a performance win. The external comparison used an explicitly patched upstream runtime.
decision: Preserve the cause and patch identity for future runtime comparisons; do not apply the old patch automatically to this project.
